routing_contract.when_to_use: Use when planning or restructuring a site (page hierarchy, navigation, URL taxonomy, hub/spoke topic clusters, visual sitemap) OR when fixing internal link structure (orphan pages, anchor-text distribution, authority flow, crawl depth). One skill, two altitudes: architecture designs the structure; linking optimizes the links inside it.
